messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["sudden numbness or weakness on one side of the body", "sudden numbness or weakness", "muscle weakness in lower body", "if on one of these combinations", "numbness", "other parts of the body", "enlargement of the walls of the left side of the heart", "confusion or weakness", "reduced feeling or numbness in the mouth", "tingling or numbness in the arms and legs", "weakness", "changes in the shape or location of body fat", "increasing the amount of urine the body makes", "sudden loss of vision", "unusual tiredness or weakness", "muscle pain or weakness"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
